bullet: Second server refused while the owner lives (`F31.second-instance-lease-held`).
script:
B=$(control-agent-server launch --new --name f31-held --share-conversations-from "$AGENT_SERVER_VERIFY_RUN" --print-run)
trap 'control-agent-server stop --run "$B" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
OWNER=$(control-agent-server state cat owner_lease.json --conversation "$X" | jq -r .content.owner_instance_id)
NX=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/events/count" --field .)
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/events/search" --run "$B" --expect 404 --check detail eq "Conversation not found: $X" \
  --save F31.second-instance-lease-held/events-search
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/events/count" --run "$B" --expect 404
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/events" --run "$B" --json '{"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "qa-f31-from-b"}], "run": false}' --expect 404
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/run" --run "$B" --expect 404 --save F31.second-instance-lease-held/run
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/agent_final_response" --run "$B" --expect 404
control-agent-server api PATCH "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X" --run "$B" --json '{"title": "QA F31 from B"}' --expect 200 --check success eq false \
  --save F31.second-instance-lease-held/patch
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/pause" --run "$B" --expect 400
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/interrupt" --run "$B" --expect 400
control-agent-server api DELETE "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X" --run "$B" --expect 400 --save F31.second-instance-lease-held/delete
control-agent-server ws listen "/sockets/events/$X" --run "$B" --expect-close 4004 --duration 10 --save F31.second-instance-lease-held/socket
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X" --run "$B" --expect 200 --check title eq 'QA F31 shared' --quiet
control-agent-server state cat owner_lease.json --conversation "$X" --check owner_instance_id eq "$OWNER" --check generation eq 1
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X" --check title eq 'QA F31 shared' --quiet
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X/events/count" --check . eq "$NX"
control-agent-server state grep qa-f31-shared-marker --glob "server/workspace/conversations/${X//-/}/**/*"
control-agent-server state grep qa-f31-from-b --glob "server/workspace/conversations/${X//-/}/**/*" --expect-none
control-agent-server stop --run "$B"
trap - EXIT
